focus: Question binding: moved.question_id must match declared research question, not merely arbitrary nonempty string or operational qid. Owner must be allowed by bound config/contract.
Dropped ack receipts: can worker self-author ack:true for another owner? Need attributable receipt, not self-attested JSON; same-user isolation limitation must be honest.
Stamp path/size/hash validation across CLI decide, claim, on-pass auto-close and restart/replay; director stamp persistence for later independent measurement, not validation-only lost artifact.
Malformed/absent claim/stamp fault must retain evidence and be owned; route must not silently dead-end. Failed/incomplete remains recordable.
Actual-start metric must join exact action+owner+question and deadline; first arbitrary same-question start is insufficient.
Prospective migration, old contract preserved, rollback cannot silently waive stamped in-flight contract; R21 memory trial must remain isolated from injected rule.
